record.original_question: In the D1-D5 AdS3/CFT2 correspondence, which correlators of chiral primary operators beyond the single-particle three-point functions already matched are protected by non-renormalization theorems? The problem includes determining whether extremal and next-to-extremal n-point functions, and three-point functions involving multi-particle chiral primaries, match across string theory on AdS3 x S3 x X4, the symmetric-orbifold CFT, and supergravity once the necessary nonlinear operator mixings are included.

evidence.quote: One might wish to explore whether other correlators are protected by non-renormalization theorems.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Consider the D1–D5 AdS3/CFT2 correspondence, in which type IIB string theory on AdS_3 × S^3 × X_4 (with X_4 either T^4 or K3) is dual to a two‑dimensional N=(4,4) superconformal field theory whose moduli space contains the symmetric-orbifold point Sym^N(X_4). Both sides possess a chiral ring of half‑BPS chiral primary operators, organized as single‑particle (single‑trace) operators O_k and their multi‑particle (multi‑trace) composites, the latter requiring nonlinear admixtures of multi‑particle states to be properly identified with Kaluza–Klein supergravity modes on AdS_3 × S^3.

Known result. The three-point functions of single-particle chiral primaries are known to agree, after suitable nonlinear redefinitions, between the symmetric-orbifold CFT and tree-level supergravity on AdS_3 × S^3 × X_4.

Problem. Determine which further correlators of chiral primary operators in this duality are protected by non-renormalization theorems, in the sense that they coincide (up to the standard nonlinear operator mixing) between the symmetric-orbifold CFT, tree-level supergravity on AdS_3 × S^3 × X_4, and string theory on this background. Specifically:

(a) Show whether extremal n-point functions ⟨O_{k_1} O_{k_2} ⋯ O_{k_n}⟩ with k_1 = k_2 + ⋯ + k_n are non-renormalized and have space‑time form fixed (as in the free field limit) by a product of (n−1) two‑point functions times a coefficient independent of the modulus along which one interpolates between the orbifold and supergravity points.

(b) Show whether next-to-extremal n-point functions, where k_1 = k_2 + ⋯ + k_n − 2, enjoy an analogous non-renormalization property.

(c) Show whether three-point functions ⟨A B C⟩ in which one or more of A, B, C is a multi-particle chiral primary match across the same three descriptions once the necessary nonlinear (multi‑particle) operator mixings are included.

Provide proofs of the non-renormalization theorems in each case, or counterexamples.
artifact.status_search_result: Partial progress exists. Single-particle three-point functions of chiral primaries in D1–D5 AdS3/CFT2 are known to match after nonlinear mixing. The covariant-constancy of the N=(4,4) chiral ring over moduli space has been established (de Boer–Manschot–Papadodimas–Verlinde, 2008) and recently extended via spectral-flow arguments (Giusto et al., 2023), giving non-renormalization for protected three-point structure constants. Analogues of the extremal and next-to-extremal non-renormalization theorems—well established in N=4 SYM (D'Hoker–Erdmenger–Freedman–Pérez-Victoria, Eden et al.)—have not been fully proved for AdS3/CFT2 multi-particle correlators in general, so the broader question remains open.

status_evidence.title: The chiral ring of AdS3/CFT2 and the attractor mechanism
status_evidence.snippet: For N=(4,4) theories the chiral ring is covariantly constant over the moduli space, a non-renormalization theorem for three-point functions of chiral primaries in AdS3/CFT2.
status_evidence.claim: Three-point functions of chiral primaries in AdS3/CFT2 satisfy a non-renormalization theorem.

status_evidence.title: Spectral flow and the exact AdS3/CFT2 chiral ring
status_evidence.snippet: Spectral-flow arguments yielding exact statements about the AdS3/CFT2 chiral ring.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work extends the non-renormalization of chiral-ring structure constants in AdS3/CFT2.

status_evidence.title: Extremal Correlators in the AdS/CFT Correspondence
status_evidence.snippet: Extremal n-point functions of chiral primaries take a factorized form with non-renormalized coefficient.
status_evidence.claim: Extremal non-renormalization theorems are established in higher-dimensional AdS/CFT but their full AdS3/CFT2 analogues are not.

status_evidence.title: Non-renormalization of next-to-extremal correlators in N=4 SYM and the AdS/CFT correspondence
status_evidence.snippet: Next-to-extremal correlators in N=4 SYM are non-renormalized.
status_evidence.claim: Next-to-extremal non-renormalization is proved in N=4 SYM; AdS3/CFT2 analogue remains incomplete.
